Durability of hyperscaler/AI data-center and digital-infrastructure capex - the leg management has now underwritten five years forward ("we expect our data center services revenue to remain elevated at about 25% annually for the next five years and then above 15% as the build cycle matures", 2026Q2) and which already carried ~14% of FY2025 core EBITDA (2025Q4). It is the one variable that simultaneously drives the services growth algorithm, the BOE/Project Management operating leverage, and the REI land-bank monetizations on which the guidance RANGE explicitly hinges.
